examples.text: suddhaṃ dhammasamuppādaṃ, suddhaṃ saṅkhārasantatiṃ, passantassa yathābhūtaṃ, na bhayaṃ hoti gāmaṇi.
dukkhaṃ dukkhasamuppādaṃ, dukkhassa ca atikkamaṃ, ariyaṃ c'aṭṭh'aṅgikaṃ maggaṃ, dukkh'ūpasamagāminaṃ.
idha, bhante, koci'd'eva dhammo samuppādo uppajjeyya, ekato assa bhagavā ekato bhikkhusaṅgho ca. yen'eva bhagavā ten'ev'āhaṃ assaṃ, evaṃ pasannaṃ maṃ, bhante, bhagavā dhāretu
appako vata me santo, kāmo vellitakesiyā, anekabhāvo samuppādi, arahante'va dakkhiṇā.

60113.meaning1: discusses; chats; converses in a friendly manner

examples.text: manussā'pi sudaṃ antarāmagge kasantā ca vapantā ca maddantā ca kammāni ca karontā theraṃ tath'āgacchantaṃ disvā ayaṃ thero punappunaṃ nivattitvā gacchati. kiṃ nu kho maggamūḷho udāhu kiñci pamuṭṭho'ti samullapanti.

60116.meaning1: talking in a friendly manner; chatting
60116.commentary: (VINa) kālayuttaṃ samullapanto'ti kālaṃ sallakkhetvā yadā na añño koci samīpena gacchati vā āgacchati vā tadā tadanurūpaṃ kacci na ukkaṇṭhasi, na kilamasi, na chātāsī'tiādikaṃ gehassitaṃ kathaṃ kathento.

examples.text: atha kho āyasmā udāyī yena sā kumārikā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā tassā kumārikāya saddhiṃ eko ekāya raho paṭicchanne āsane alaṃkammaniye nisajjaṃ kappesi kālayuttaṃ samullapanto kālayuttaṃ dhammaṃ bhaṇanto

60121.synonym: kaḷebara, kaḷevara, kāyadhātu, gahaka, deha, bhastā, sandeha, sarīra

examples.text: niṭṭhaṅ'gato asantāsī, vītataṇho anaṅgaṇo, acchindi bhavasallāni, antimo'yaṃ samussayo.

evaṃ tasmiñ'ca sannipāte dvādasa bhikkhusatasahassāni sannipatiṃsu āyasmatā yasena samussāhitā. tesaṃ majjhe āyasmatā revatena puṭṭhena sabbakāmittherena vinayaṃ vissajjentena tāni dasa vatthūni vinicchitāni, adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasamitaṃ.
desesi karuṇāvega, samussāhitamānaso, yaṃ ve devamanussānaṃ, pītipāmojjavaḍḍhanaṃ.

60127.grammar: pr, caus of saṃ ud √sah, trans (+acc)
60127.commentary: (ANt) gaṇhāpetī'ti te dhamme manasā anupakkhite diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhe kārento uggaṇhāpeti. samussāhetī'ti samādhimhi ussāhaṃ janeti.

examples.text: samādapetī'ti gaṇhāpeti. samuttejetī'ti samussāheti. sampahaṃsetī'ti paṭiladdhaguṇehi vaṇṇaṃ kathento vodāpeti.

60128.meaning1: having stirred; having aroused; having instigated; having incited
60128.meaningLit: having caused to overcome up together

examples.text: samādapesī'ti gaṇhāpesi. samuttejesī'ti samussāhesi. sampahaṃsesī'ti paṭiladdhaguṇena modāpesi.
passa cittakataṃ bimbaṃ, arukāyaṃ samussitaṃ, āturaṃ bahusaṅkappaṃ, yassa n'atthi dhuvaṃ ṭhiti.
ye viruddhā sallapanti, viniviṭṭhā samussitā, anariyaguṇam'āsajja, añño'ññavivar'esino.
aññāt'atthaṃ pasād'atthaṃ, sataṃ ve hoti mantanā, evaṃ kho ariyā mantenti, esā ariyāna mantanā, etadaññāya medhāvī, na samusseyya mantaye'ti.

60134.meaning1: engaged in battle; involved in war; (comm) engaged forehead to forehead in giving blows
60134.construction: saṃ + upa + vi + √yūh + ta > yūḍha > yūḷha

examples.text: bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, dev'āsurasaṅgāmo samūpabyuḷho ahosi. atha kho, bhikkhave, vepacitti asur'indo asure āmantesi

60135.meaning1: with the root; at the source; together with the foundation

examples.text: bhavarāmāya vata, bho, pajāya bhavaratāya bhavasammuditāya samūlaṃ bhavaṃ udabbahī'ti.
nikkhipitvā garuṃ bhāraṃ, aññaṃ bhāraṃ anādiya, samūlaṃ taṇham'abbuyha, nicchāto parinibbuto'ti.

60136.meaning1: together with the root; roots and all
60136.construction:
sa + √mūl + a + ka
sa + mūla + ka

examples.text: n'atthi hi loke sadevake, rāgo yattha'pi dāni me siyā, na'pi naṃ jānāmi kīriso, atha maggena hato samūlako.

60138.commentary: (DNt) yadi'pi avayavavinimutto samudāyo nāma koci n'atthi avayavaṃ upādāya samudāyassa vattabbattā, aviññāyamānasamudāyaṃ pana viññāyamānasamudāyena visesitum'arahatī'ti āha aṭṭhannam'pi samūhan'ti, etena ariyasaṅghan'ti ettha na yena kenaci saṇṭhān'ādinā, kāyasāmaggiyā vā samudāyabhāvo, api tu maggaṭṭha-phalaṭṭha-bhāven'evā'ti viseseti. avayavameva sampiṇḍetvā ūhitabbo vitakketabbo, saṃūhanitabbo vā saṅghaṭitabboti samūho, so'y'eva samoho vacanasiliṭṭhat'ādinā.

examples.text: sugatassa orasānaṃ, puttānaṃ mārasenamathanānaṃ, aṭṭhannam'pi samūhaṃ, sirasā vande ariyasaṅghaṃ.

60139.commentary: (ANt) samūhaggāho'ti taṇhā-māna-diṭṭhīnaṃ sādhāraṇaggāho'ti vadanti, itthaṃ evaṃ aññathā'ti pana visesaṃ akatvā gahaṇaṃ samūhaggāho'ti daṭṭhabbo.

60140.meaning1: removing; uprooting; digging up; pulling out

examples.text: diṭṭhiyogaṃ samūhacca, avijjañ'ca virājayaṃ, sabbayogavisaṃyuttā, te ve yog'ātigā munī'ti.
pariciṇṇo mayā satthā, kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ, ohito garuko bhāro, bhavanetti samūhatā.
atthaṅ'gatassa na pamāṇam'atthi, yena naṃ vajjuṃ taṃ tassa n'atthi, sabbesu dhammesu samūhatesu, samūhatā vādapathā'pi sabbe'ti.
tayo vitakke kusale vitakkaye, tayo pana akusale nirākare, sa ve vitakkāni vicāritāni, sameti vuṭṭhī'va rajaṃ samūhataṃ, sa ve vitakk'ūpasamena cetasā, idh'eva so santipadaṃ samajjhagā'ti.

60143.construction:
saṃ + √yūh > ūh + a + tā
samūha + tā

60144.meaning1: uproots; eradicates; exterminates; utterly destroys; gets rid of; kills off

examples.text: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, aniccasaññā bhāvitā bahulīkatā sabbaṃ kāmarāgaṃ pariyādiyati sabbaṃ rūparāgaṃ pariyādiyati sabbaṃ bhavarāgaṃ pariyādiyati sabbaṃ avijjaṃ pariyādiyati sabbaṃ asmimānaṃ samūhanati.
aham'etaṃ dassukhīlaṃ vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā pabbājanāya vā samūhanissāmī'ti

60145.commentary: (DNa) samūhanatū'ti ākaṅkhamāno samūhanatu, yadi icchati samūhaneyyā'ti attho. kasmā pana samūhanathā'ti ek'aṃsen'eva avatvā vikappavacanen'eva ṭhapesī'ti? mahākassapassa balaṃ diṭṭhattā. passati hi bhagavā, samūhanathā'ti vutte'pi saṅgītikāle kassapo na samūhanissatī'ti. tasmā vikappen'eva ṭhapesi.

examples.text: ākaṅkhamāno, ānanda, saṅgho mam'accayena khudd'ānukhuddakāni sikkhāpadāni samūhanatu.

60146.meaning1: having uprooted; having eradicated; having exterminated; having utterly destroyed

examples.text: so sabbaso rāg'ānusayaṃ pahāya, paṭigh'ānusayaṃ paṭivinodetvā, asmī'ti diṭṭhimān'ānusayaṃ samūhanitvā, avijjaṃ pahāya vijjaṃ uppādetvā, diṭṭh'evadhamme dukkhass'antakaro hoti

60147.commentary: (DNa) kusalena samekkhasī'ti anavajjena nipuṇena vā sabbaññutaññāṇena mahājanaṃ olokesi.
60147.notes: ikkh > ekkh probably due to the influence of pekkhati, upekkhā, etc.

examples.text: namo te puris'ājañña, namo te puris'uttama, kusalena samekkhasi, amanussā'pi taṃ vandanti, sutaṃ n'etaṃ abhiṇhaso, tasmā evaṃ vademase.

60148.notes: ikkh > ekkh probably due to the influence of pekkhati, upekkhā, etc.

60149.notes: ikkh > ekkh probably due to the influence of pekkhati, upekkhā, etc.

examples.text: yam'pi, bhikkhave, tathāgato purimaṃ jātiṃ purimaṃ bhavaṃ purimaṃ niketaṃ pubbe manussabhūto samāno mahājanasaṅgahaṃ samekkhamāno samaṃ jānāti sāmaṃ jānāti, purisaṃ jānāti purisavisesaṃ jānāti, ayam'idam'arahati ayam'idam'arahatī'ti tattha tattha purisavisesakaro ahosi.

60150.notes: ikkh > ekkh probably due to the influence of pekkhati, upekkhā, etc.

60151.notes: ikkh > ekkh probably due to the influence of pekkhati, upekkhā, etc.

60152.notes: ikkh > ekkh probably due to the influence of pekkhati, upekkhā, etc.

60153.commentary: (DNa) attānaṃ vighāse samekkhiyā'ti soṇḍiyaṃ ucchiṭṭh'odake thūlaṃ attabhāvaṃ disvā.
60153.notes: ikkh > ekkh probably due to the influence of pekkhati, upekkhā, etc.

examples.text: aññaṃ anucaṅkamanaṃ, attānaṃ vighāse samekkhiya, yāva attānaṃ na passati, kotthu tāva byaggho'ti maññati.

60154.meaning1: thinking; considering; supposing; perceiving oneself to be
60154.notes: ikkh > ekkh probably due to the influence of pekkhati, upekkhā, etc.

examples.text: sīho'ti attānaṃ samekkhiyāna, amaññi kotthu migarāj'āham'asmi, tath'evaso siṅgālakaṃ anadi, ke ca chave siṅgāle ke pana sīhanāde'ti.

60155.meaning1: with a handle; with a strap

examples.text: te c'āpi nūnappajaheyyu dukkhaṃ, ye tvaṃ muni aṭṭhitaṃ ovadeyya, taṃ taṃ namassāmi samecca nāga, app'eva maṃ bhagavā aṭṭhitaṃ ovadeyya.
kim'idaṃ kusalaṃ kim'ācarema, icc'eke hi samecca mantayanti, te mayaṃ punareva laddha mānusattaṃ, paṭipannā viharemu sīlavanto.
sayaṃ samādāya vatāni jantu, ucc'āvacaṃ gacchati saññasatto, vidvā ca vedehi samecca dhammaṃ, na ucc'āvacaṃ gacchati bhūripañño.
te c'āpi nūnappajaheyyu dukkhaṃ, ye tvaṃ muni aṭṭhitaṃ ovadeyya, taṃ taṃ namassāmi samecca nāga, app'eva maṃ bhagavā aṭṭhitaṃ ovadeyya.

60158.meaning1: (of a state of being) attained; come to; arrived (at)

examples.text: kathaṃ sametassa vibhoti rūpaṃ, sukhaṃ dukhañ'cā'pi kathaṃ vibhoti, etaṃ me pabrūhi yathā vibhoti, taṃ jāniyāmā'ti me mano ahu.
na saññasaññī na visaññasaññī, no'pi asaññī na vibhūtasaññī. evaṃ sametassa vibhoti rūpaṃ, saññānidānā hi papañcasaṅkhā.

60160.meaningLit: may it agree for the venerables
60160.commentary: (VINa) samet'āyasmantānaṃ saṅghenā'ti āyasmantānaṃ cittaṃ saṅghena saddhiṃ sametu samāgacchatu, ekībhāvaṃ yātū'ti vuttaṃ hoti.
60160.notes: commentary takes āyasmantānaṃ as genitive, SCPN §98 takes as dative of interest

examples.text: m'āyasmantānam'pi saṅghabhedo ruccittha, samet'āyasmantānaṃ saṅghena, samaggo hi saṅgho sammodamāno avivadamāno ek'uddeso phāsu viharatī'ti.

60161.meaning1: may the venerable agree; venerable be at peace (with)
60161.commentary: (VINa) samet'āyasmā saṅghenā'ti āyasmā saṅghena saddhiṃ sametu samāgacchatu ekaladdhiko hotū'ti attho.

examples.text: samet'āyasmā saṅghena, samaggo hi saṅgho sammodamāno avivadamāno ek'uddeso phāsu viharatī'ti

60162.meaning1: calms down; settles; stills; makes subside

examples.text: tayo vitakke kusale vitakkaye, tayo pana akusale nirākare, sa ve vitakkāni vicāritāni, sameti vuṭṭhī'va rajaṃ samūhataṃ.
yo ca sameti pāpāni, aṇuṃ thūlāni sabbaso, samitattā hi pāpānaṃ, samaṇo'ti pavuccati.
ete ca ñatvā upanissitā'ti, ñatvā munī nissaye so vimaṃsī, ñatvā vimutto na vivādam'eti, bhav'ābhavāya na sameti dhīro'ti.

60164.commentary: (MNa) sametī'ti ekanāḷiyā mitaṃ viya ekatulāya tulitaṃ viya sadisaṃ hoti ninnānākaraṇaṃ. (ANa) samessatī'ti samānaṃ bhavissati.

examples.text: mayā'pi kho etaṃ, bho gotama, sutaṃ pubbakānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ, ārogyaparamā lābhā, nibbānaṃ paramaṃ sukhan'ti. ta'y'idaṃ, bho gotama, sametī'ti.
so, duggataṃ durūpetan'ti pāḷiyā na sameti, tasmā vuttanayen'ev'ettha bhāvanam'ārabhitvā sīmāsambhedaṃ katvā appanā vaḍḍhetabbā.

60165.construction:
saṃ + e + ta + ika
sameta + ika
60165.commentary: (SNa) cirarattaṃsametikā'ti dīgharattaṃ saṃsanditvā sametvā ṭhitaladdhino. te kira pañcajātisatāni ekato'va vicariṃsu.

examples.text: sahāyā vat'ime bhikkhū, cirarattaṃ sametikā, sameti nesaṃ saddhammo, dhamme buddhappavedite.

60166.construction:
sa + √mitt > mett + *ā + a
sa + mettā + a
60166.synonym: abyāpajja, abyābajjha, avera, metta, mettāvihārī, sakhila

60167.meaning2: having come together, having met, having agreed with

60168.grammar: ind, adv, instr sg of sama

examples.text: asāhasena dhammena, samena nayatī pare, dhammassa gutto medhāvī, dhammaṭṭho'ti pavuccati.
sāvatthiyaṃ kir'eko upāsako dhammena samena agāraṃ ajjhāvasati

60169.grammar: pp of caus of saṃ √īr, caus

examples.text: samantam'asāro loko, disā sabbā sameritā, icchaṃ bhavanam'attano, n'āddasāsiṃ anositaṃ.
ten'eva so sugatim'upecca modati, sukhapphalaṃ kariya sukhāni vindati, sam'ojasā rasaharaṇī susaṇṭhitā, idh'āgato labhati rasaggas'aggitaṃ.

60182.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of samodaka
60182.meaning1: level with the water; at the same height as the water

examples.text: app'ekaccāni uppalāni vā padumāni vā puṇḍarīkāni vā udake jātāni udake saṃvaḍḍhāni udak'ānuggatāni sam'odakaṃ ṭhitāni, app'ekaccāni uppalāni vā padumāni vā puṇḍarīkāni vā udake jātāni udake saṃvaḍḍhāni udakaṃ accuggamma ṭhitāni anupalittāni udakena.

60183.commentary: (SNa) kāyam'pi citte samodahatī'ti kāyaṃ gahetvā citte āropeti, cittasannissitaṃ karoti, cittagatiyā peseti. cittaṃ nāma mahaggatacittaṃ, cittagatigamanaṃ lahukaṃ hoti. cittam'pi kāye samodahatī'ti cittaṃ gahetvā kāye āropeti, kāyasannissitaṃ karoti, kāyagatiyā peseti, kāyo nāma karajakāyo, kāyagatigamanaṃ dandhaṃ hoti.

examples.text: yasmiṃ, ānanda, samaye tathāgato kāyam'pi citte samodahati cittam'pi kāye samodahati, sukhasaññañ'ca lahusaññañ'ca kāye okkamitvā viharati, tasmiṃ, ānanda, samaye tathāgatassa kāyo lahutaro c'eva hoti mudutaro ca kammaniyataro ca pabhassarataro ca.
kummo aṅgāni sake kapāle, samodahaṃ bhikkhu manovitakke, anissito aññam'aheṭhayāno, parinibbuto n'ūpavadeyya kañcī'ti.

60189.meaning1: having drawn; having withdrawn; having pulled (in)
60189.meaning2: having put together, having kept in

examples.text: addasā kho, bhikkhave, kummo kacchapo siṅgālaṃ dūrato'va gocarapasutaṃ. disvāna soṇḍipañcamāni aṅgāni sake kapāle samodahitvā app'ossukko tuṇhībhūto saṅkasāyati.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, yāni kānici jaṅgalānaṃ pāṇānaṃ padajātāni, sabbāni tāni hatthipade samodhānaṃ gacchanti, hatthipadaṃ tesaṃ aggam'akkhāyati, yadidaṃ mahantattena
tisso imā, bhikkhave, sikkhā yatth'etaṃ sabbaṃ samodhānaṃ gacchati. katamā tisso? adhisīlasikkhā, adhicittasikkhā, adhipaññāsikkhā.
ye vā pan'assa te honti anatthakāmā ahitakāmā aphāsukakāmā ayogakkhemakāmā, yā tehi saddhiṃ saṅgati samāgamo samodhānaṃ missībhāvo, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, appiyehi sampayogo dukkho.

60193.meaning1: is contained in; fits inside; is comprised within

examples.text: tisso imā, bhikkhave, sikkhā yatth'etaṃ sabbaṃ samodhānaṃ gacchati. katamā tisso? adhisīlasikkhā, adhicittasikkhā, adhipaññāsikkhā.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, yāni kānici jaṅgalānaṃ pāṇānaṃ padajātāni, sabbāni tāni hatthipade samodhānaṃ gacchanti, hatthipadaṃ tesaṃ aggam'akkhāyati, yadidaṃ mahantattena

60194.meaning2: to be collected; to be gathered

60195.meaning1: should be grouped together; should be combined (in)

examples.text: idāni tīsu'pi dvāresu āyūhanacetanā samodhānetabbā. seyyath'idaṃ, kāyadvāre sayaṃkatamūlikā vīsati cetanā, āṇattimūlikā vīsati, sampajānamūlikā vīsati, asampajānamūlikā vīsatī'ti asīti cetanā honti, tathā vacīdvāre.
tapojigucchāya susaṃvut'atto, vācaṃ pahāya kalahaṃ janena, samosavajjā virato saccavādī, na hi nūna tādisaṃ karoti pāpan'ti.
